name: BlazePhoenix
description: Read-only MCP server for the BlazePhoenix on-chain DEX aggregator on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain. Quotes are computed by the on-chain Quoter contract as a free eth_call on your own RPC node: net output after the fee, the minimum output the Router enforces, price impact and the Phoenix Check verdict. Also builds verified unsigned Router calldata, simulates a swap, reads token info and the deployment registry, and verifies deployments on-chain. It never signs and never holds a key. The hosted endpoint makes no RPC calls: it returns the exact eth_call for your node and decodes the result.
author: BlazePhoenix

BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_URL.description: One RPC node URL used for every chain it serves. Use either this or the per-chain variables (BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_BASE, _ETHEREUM, _OPTIMISM, _ARBITRUM, _ROBINHOOD).
